metadata.title: Robinhood, Arm, Carvana: Stocks moving on earnings in after-hours

content.text:
Oops, something went wrong
Asking for a Trend Host Josh Lipton eyes several stocks making moves in after-hours trading, including Robinhood Markets (HOOD), Arm Holdings (ARM), and Carvana (CVNA) after reporting their latest earnings results.
Robin Hood shares edging lower after earnings despite topping Wall Street's estimates and reporting a double digit revenue gain.
The mobile trading platform seeing higher activity spurred by market volatility. Still, crypto has weighed on that company this year with Bitcoin down nearly 50% in the last 12 months.
Shares of Robin Hood have struggled as well, down about 20% year to date. Shares of Arm Holdings, they're under pressure that company that's coming after the chip designer reported quarterly earnings that did top analyst estimates.
Investors seemingly underwhelmed though by the company's outlook while concerns remain around smartphone demand.
One bright spot was data center where royalties more than doubled and demand for Arms new AI chip continues to build.
And lastly, Carvana stock, that's sinking in after hours trading following its second quarter results. The online auto retailer reporting better than expected revenue for the quarter as adjusted EBIDA only came in slightly above expectations.
But looking ahead, the company's guidance for full year adjusted EBIDA did disappoint the street.
